name: GAN i4 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN i4 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube is a premium magnetic speed cube built for cubers who want top-tier turning feel with smart training features built in.
features: Smart practice tools: Zero-loss sensing and omni-motion monitoring help track your turning data so you can practice more intentionally.
Fast, premium feel: Magnetic turning, MagLev, and Ball-Core technology work together to create a quick, stable, more controlled solve.
Real-time cube tracking: The smart gyroscope displays all 360 degrees of the cube in real time with no lag.
Flexible battery use: Full power and endurance modes let you choose between maximum smart functionality or longer battery life.
Strong smart cube ecosystem: Built for a growing smartcubing community with over 1.5 million players.
72 handfeel options: Designed to give you a wide range of setup possibilities.
